Q: How to maintain scale when rotating? A:

Don't change the scale after the initial calculation. Once you've created a "frame" for your image, the vertices and tex coords, with the right aspect ratio and dimensions that will fit within the window, you can rotate it as much as you like without needing to change anything.

Q: What C functions or C++ class help displaying text screen like top or btop commands do? A:

These types of display rely on ANSI escape codes: terminals (and terminal emulators) support in-band escape codes that represent display commands such as “change the output colour”, “move to these screen coordinates”, “clear the rest of the line”.

A common library for this is ncurses, or more generally, a curses library, but it’s not required. Terminal capabilities are made available through terminfo, and many programs use that. But there aren’t any corresponding “standard” C/C++ functions; any method to write to a terminal can be used to implement these displays.

top from procps relies on curses; btop doesn’t use a library, it hard-codes the ANSI sequences it needs.

Q: error parsing called workflow in github . workflow was not found A:

If you have checked that you have the correct Workflow permissions on the target repository and you still get the error, double check that the calling repository is a private repository and not set to internal as it will also cause the same error.

Q: Is CPU allowed to perform a speculative execution on nullptr branch conditions? A:

Yet still CPU does not know about programs. That's OS concept. Nor it knows about crashing, that is an OS concept also. CPU would simply trap an invalid memory access, and that's it. That might result in a program crash (rather signal being sent to the the program), or it might result in, say, paging in memory from external storage or COW page cloning. CPU doesn't know anything of that, it only peddles in instructions and exceptions.

Q: Command Prompt- The system cannot find the path specified A:
  • Make sure that you don't have any wrong paths with any Windows specified type files in Registry Editor.

I just had this problem because I had a .bat file running in regedit at this path but moved that file without changing it's path in regedit. It produces The system cannot find the path specified. because if you move a startup file without also changing its path in regedit, then it will fail to find the file.
